Board can give up 50 mm² now. Routability needs ≥0.95, which is about 1197 mm², so I'm claiming 1200 mm² (about 0.952). That is 2688 mm³, down 112 mm³ from 2800, with almost no margin left. I can't go lower.

That still leaves the interior over by about 1134 mm³. The rest has to come from other domains:
- Battery at 3786 mm³ and antenna at 1500 mm³ are the biggest blocks.
- Structure at 1800 mm³ and acoustics at 1460 mm³ are the next largest.

I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall. I'm OBJECTing only because the pool is still over-committed, not because my own requirement fails.

Battery is at 59.78 h with the 4.73 mm cell, and the stack is OK (4.73 + 2.24 = 6.97 ≤ 7.1). Runtime scales almost linearly with volume, about 0.0158 h/mm³. Each 100 mm³ I give up costs about 1.6 h, and it also cuts siren endurance, which depends on the same energy.

I can't close a 1134 mm³ gap. Even a 10% cut (-380 mm³) would drop runtime to about 54 h. I'll probe small trims now and can give a modest amount once acoustics confirms the siren energy margin.

Caseback has 23 mm² of headroom. Widening the cell footprint doesn't save volume. Antenna, acoustics, structure and thermal need to carry most of the cut. I'm not asking to reopen the wall or the port.

Antenna can contribute, but I don't yet know how steeply L5 efficiency falls as V_ant shrinks. L5 is 0.208 at 1500 mm³ and a 1.2 mm wall. I'm trimming to 1400 mm³ now (-100) and probing 1300 and 1100 to find the knee.

Perimeter has room: antenna plus NFC is 1900 of 2400 mm³ at my claim. NFC doesn't need to shrink for perimeter reasons. I'm also probing a thinner wall as a what-if only. It would free 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm and may help L5, but I'm not asking to reopen the wall.

I still OBJECT because the interior is over-committed.

Thermal is at its limit. At 320 mm² (250 mm³) skin temperature is 43.0 °C against the 43 °C cap, so I have no margin to give back in this round. I can't offer a cut yet, but I can map the trade-off. I'm probing 300 mm² to see how steep the slope is. I'm also probing a thinner wall (1.1 mm) at 320 and at 280 mm². That is a what-if only, because I'm not asking to reopen the wall. Thermal is only 250 mm³ of the 1034 mm³ gap, so the cut has to come from the larger blocks. Caseback headroom is 23 mm², so I can't take more area either. I still OBJECT because the interior is over-committed, not because my own requirement fails.

Structure fails its own requirement. Pressure margin is 1.438 against the 1.5 minimum at a 1.2 mm wall, a 9.0 mm² port and 1800 mm³ of ribs. I can't give volume back yet, and closing the margin may cost interior.

I'm not asking to reopen the wall or port. I'm probing three cases to find the cheapest fix:
- ribs at 2000 mm³
- port at 8 mm² (what-if only)
- a trade of ribs down to 1500 mm³ for a 1.3 mm wall, which is roughly volume-neutral

The gap is still about 1034 mm³. Battery, antenna and acoustics will have to carry most of it. I OBJECT because my own requirement fails.

Acoustics fails its own requirement. The siren needs 9.08 W for 86 dB, against the 1.0 W cap, which gives only 0.34 h of endurance. Getting to ≥3 h means cutting siren power about 9×, not trimming volume.

The cause is resonance at 5.6 kHz, too high for the siren band, with a 40 rayl mesh adding loss. My fix is to drop the mesh to the 20 rayl floor and lengthen h_out to pull resonance down. I'm not asking to reopen the port or wall, and I'm holding the port at 9 mm². Structure's pressure fix should come from ribs or from a smaller port, which I can discuss if it is needed.

I can't give back volume until the probes show how much the siren depends on V_acou. Battery energy is also tied to siren endurance, so battery shouldn't shrink much.

Haptics can give back volume. My force is 1.069 N at 350 mm³, which is about 0.00305 N/mm³ if it scales linearly. That puts the 0.9 N floor at about 295 mm³. I'm claiming 310 mm³ (-40), which should give about 0.945 N, a ~5% margin. I'll probe 295 and 325 to check the linearity.

That is only 40 mm³ of the roughly 994 mm³ gap, so the bigger blocks still have to move. I'm not asking to reopen the port or wall. Structure's pressure fix needs to be volume-neutral, and acoustics' siren-power fix should come from resonance tuning rather than extra volume.

I OBJECT only because the interior is still over-committed. My own requirement is met.

NFC has 8.2 mm of margin: 18.2 mm read range against the 10 mm requirement. I can give volume back. I'm cutting the loop from 320 to 260 mm³ and the ferrite from 180 to 150 mm³. That is -90 mm³ for NFC, from 500 to 410 mm³. I expect range to stay above 10 mm, but I don't yet know the slope.

I'm probing the 180/110 floor and two midpoints. If the floor still reads ≥10 mm, I'll cut further next round. I'm not asking to reopen the port or wall.

I still OBJECT because the interior is over-committed. NFC's own requirement is met.

Board holds at 1200 mm² (2688 mm³). Routability is 0.952, and the 1197 mm² probe sits exactly on the 0.95 limit. Anything below 1197 fails (1180 gives 0.937). I'll keep the ~3 mm² of margin, since going to 1197 would save only 7 mm³.

The ledger is still 904 mm³ over, and the open items push it higher:
- Structure's fix (+200 mm³ of ribs) would raise the gap.
- Acoustics' siren fix may need volume too.
- Battery can't shrink without losing runtime and siren endurance.

If the antenna and acoustics probes don't show a large volume saving, we may have to revisit the wall or port after all. I'd rather see those numbers first.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is over-committed. My own requirement is met.

Battery holds at 3786 mm³ and 800 mm² this round, at 59.78 h. The stack is 4.73 mm plus 2.24 mm of board, which is within the 7.1 mm limit.

I'm probing three cuts to confirm the 0.0158 h/mm³ slope: 3700 (about 58.4 h), 3650 and 3500. Anything under about 3700 takes runtime below 58 h and cuts siren energy. Since acoustics hasn't yet got the siren under 1 W, I don't want to give volume until it does.

Widening the cell doesn't save volume. The 23 mm² of caseback headroom would only thin the cell.

Next round, antenna and NFC should report their knee and floor numbers. Acoustics should report the siren power needed after the mesh and h_out change. If those numbers don't close the 904 mm³ gap, battery can give a modest trim, but it can't be the main source of savings.

I OBJECT because the interior is still over-committed. My own requirement is met.

Antenna probe results: L5 efficiency is 0.208 at 1500 mm³, 0.181 at 1400, 0.156 at 1300 and 0.112 at 1100. That is a near-linear slope of about 0.00025 per mm³ with no knee down to 1100. Each 100 mm³ costs roughly 0.025 (about 14% relative). A 1.1 mm wall adds only +0.008 at 1400.

I'm claiming 1300 mm³ (-100 more), which gives L5 of 0.156. Going below that is real RF loss, so I'd rather not cut further until the other blocks report.

I'm probing 1200 mm³ and a 1.3 mm wall at 1300 mm³. The wall probe shows what structure's rib-for-wall trade would cost L5. Perimeter is fine, at 1560 of 2400 mm³.

Gap after this: about 804 mm³. I OBJECT because the pools are not balanced.

Thermal holds at 320 mm² (250 mm³). Skin temperature is 43.00 °C at the 43 °C cap, so there is no margin to give back.

Last round's probes:
- **300 mm²:** 43.24 °C, which fails. The slope is about 0.012 °C per mm², or roughly 3 mm³ of volume per 0.01 °C.
- **Wall at 1.1 mm:** worth only about 0.01 °C at 320 mm², so a thinner wall doesn't help thermal.

I'm probing a 1.3 mm wall now. That prices structure's rib-for-wall trade on my side, and it may force me up in area, which costs volume and caseback.

The ledger is still about 800 mm³ over, so I OBJECT. My own requirement is met. Acoustics should report the siren power fix next, because that decides whether battery volume can move.

Structure's requirement fails at 1.2 mm / 9 mm² / 1800 mm³ (margin 1.438). Ribs alone can't fix it: 2000 mm³ gives only 1.454. Port 8 mm² gives exactly 1.50 with zero margin, and it would hurt acoustics' siren.

The wall route is better for the ledger. At 1.3 mm with 1500 mm³ of ribs, margin is 1.61. Ribs drop 300 mm³ and the interior pool drops 150 mm³, so the gap improves by about 150 mm³. I'm claiming that, keeping the port at 9 mm². Antenna's wall probe suggests only about -0.008 L5.

I'm probing thinner-rib and intermediate-wall variants to find the cheapest passing point. Thermal and antenna, please report your 1.3 mm wall numbers.

Acoustics still fails: the siren needs 9.08 W against the 1.0 W cap, so endurance is 0.34 h. The 5.6 kHz resonance is the cause. A Helmholtz resonance scales roughly as √(port/(V·h)), so a longer h_out lowers it. I'm claiming r_mesh 20 (the floor) and h_out 2.5 this round. If that works, the siren stops being a reason to protect battery volume.

I'm holding the port at 9 mm², and the 1.3 mm wall is fine with me. I'm holding V_acou at 1460 mm³ until I see how siren power moves with volume. The probes are:
- h_out 3.2
- V_acou 1300 at h_out 2.5
- split 0.6

Volume cuts come after the siren numbers are in.

Haptics trims another 10 mm³, from 310 to 300. Probes confirm the force is linear at about 0.00307 N/mm³: 280 gives 0.855 N (fails), 295 gives 0.901 N and 325 gives 0.993 N. At 300 mm³ I expect about 0.916 N, roughly 2% above the 0.9 N floor. I won't go lower, because 295 is already at the limit.

My total contribution is -50 mm³. The remaining gap is about 745 mm³, so the larger blocks still have to move:
- Antenna and acoustics: report volume-versus-performance slopes.
- NFC: report its floor.
- Battery: a modest trim may be needed once the siren power is known.

I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall. The 1.3 mm wall doesn't change my force.

NFC goes to its floor: loop 180 mm³ and ferrite 110 mm³, which is -120 mm³ from 410 (290 total). Last round's probe gave 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement at this point. That leaves 2.7 mm of margin, and I'll confirm it at the 1.3 mm wall this round. The slope is gentle, about 0.04 mm per mm³, so I can't cut deeper because the bounds stop me.

Perimeter use drops too, with antenna plus NFC at about 1590 of 2400 mm³. The gap falls to roughly 625 mm³. That remainder has to come from battery, antenna, acoustics and structure. I'm not asking to reopen the port or wall.

I OBJECT only because the pool is still over-committed. My own requirement is met.

Board trims from 1200 to 1198 mm² (2683 mm³), a saving of about 5 mm³. The 1197 mm² probe sits exactly on the 0.95 limit, so I'm keeping 1 mm² of margin. Routability is about 0.9507 at 1198.

This barely moves the ledger. The gap is still about 620 mm³, and the board can't close it. The board is already 1.4× its share of the volume. Going below 1197 mm² fails routability and would break the 10-layer, [SoC withheld] design.

The remaining volume has to come from:
- **Acoustics:** 1460 mm³, still waiting on the siren fix.
- **Battery:** a trim once the siren power is known.
- **Antenna:** its probes show a near-linear loss with no knee.
- **Structure:** the 1.3 mm wall with 1500 mm³ of ribs.

I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall. My own requirement is met, but the interior pool is still over-committed, so I OBJECT.

Battery trims 46 mm³, from 3786 to 3740 (about 59.0 h). The slope is 0.0158 h/mm³ and is independent of footprint: 3650 at 810 mm² lands on the same line as 3700 at 800 mm². Widening the cell therefore saves no volume.

I can't go deeper yet. The siren needs 9.08 W against a 1.0 W cap, so endurance is 0.34 h. Every 100 mm³ I cut costs 1.6 h of runtime and some siren energy. If acoustics' h_out 2.5 and mesh change bring the siren near 1 W, I can trim to about 3700, which is 58.4 h.

The gap is still about 575 mm³. Acoustics holds 1460 mm³ and should show siren power against V_acou next.

Antenna at the 1.3 mm wall is 0.174 at 1400 mm³, so the wall costs about 0.007 against the 1.2 mm figure. I'm now claiming 1300 mm³ (-100). I expected that last round, but the ledger still shows 1400, so this is the actual move. It should give an L5 of about 0.149, a loss of roughly 14% relative.

I can't go much further. The slope is linear at about 0.00025 per mm³ with no knee, so every extra cut is a straight RF loss. Perimeter use is about 1480 of 2400 mm³, so that pool is not binding.

That leaves a gap of about 473 mm³. Acoustics holds 1460 mm³, and I'd like its siren numbers before I give more. I'm probing 1200 and 1250 mm³, and 1300 mm³ at a 1.2 mm wall, to price the wall trade.

Thermal has to move up slightly. At the 1.3 mm wall, 320 mm² gives 43.01 °C, which fails the 43 °C cap by 0.01 °C. The slope is about 0.012 °C/mm², so I'm claiming 324 mm² (about 42.96 °C). That costs +3 mm³ (253 mm³ total) and +4 mm² of caseback. The caseback is at 1124 of 1143 mm², so it still fits.

I can't give anything back. Thermal is now a +3 mm³ drag on the ledger, but that is small beside the roughly 475 mm³ gap. The gap has to come from acoustics, battery, antenna and structure. Acoustics, please post the siren power against V_acou so the battery and acoustics volume trades can be priced.

I OBJECT because the interior pool is still over-committed, not because of my own numbers.

Structure can give another 160 mm³ without touching the port. My probes show pressure margin is about 2.0 per mm of wall, and ribs are worth little:
- 1400 mm³ at 1.30 mm gives 1.602.
- 1400 mm³ at 1.25 mm gives 1.502, which passes by only 0.002.

I'm claiming ribs 1400 mm³ (the floor, -100) and wall 1.26 mm, for a margin of about 1.52. That wall step returns about 60 mm³ to everyone's pool.

The gap falls from 476 to about 315 mm³. Antenna and thermal, please re-price at 1.26 mm. The thinner wall should help antenna L5 and costs thermal almost nothing. I can't go below 1.25 mm.

The rest of the gap has to come from acoustics, whose 1460 mm³ is the largest soft block, and from a modest battery trim. I OBJECT because the pool is still over by about 315 mm³. My own requirement is met.

Acoustics still fails, but the lever is now clear. Split matters far more than h_out. At split 0.78 siren power is 7.5 W. At split 0.6 it is 2.03 W, and resonance falls from 5177 to 3834 Hz. h_out 3.2 only moved power from 7.47 W to 7.41 W. I'm moving split to 0.6 this round and probing lower values. SII costs 2.7 points for that step (88.4 to 85.7), so I'll check how much further it can go.

Volume and split trade against each other. A smaller V_acou raises the resonance and a lower split lowers it. If split 0.5 passes siren power at 1300 mm³, I can give back about 160 mm³. I'm not touching the port or the wall.

Haptics trims 3 mm³, from 300 to 297. The 297 probe gave 0.907 N, which is 0.007 N above the 0.9 N floor. Force is linear at about 0.00307 N/mm³ and doesn't depend on wall or port, so the 1.26 mm wall doesn't change it. I won't go below 296, since 295 sits at about 0.901 N with almost no margin.

My total contribution is now -53 mm³. After structure's move the gap is about 315 mm³, and haptics can't close it. It has to come from acoustics, with split near 0.5 and V_acou near 1300, plus a modest battery trim. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall. My own requirement is met, but the interior pool is still over-committed, so I OBJECT.

NFC is already at both floors: loop 180 mm³ and ferrite 110 mm³, which is 290 mm³ in total. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. I have no volume left to give, because the bounds stop any deeper cut. Perimeter use is about 1480 of 2400 mm³, so that pool isn't binding.

Range responds to a change in wall by only a few tenths of a millimetre at most. Structure's move to 1.26 mm doesn't threaten my margin, and I'm not asking to reopen the port or wall.

Structure's step brings the gap to about 315 mm³. That has to come from acoustics, through the split and V_acou trade, and from a modest battery trim. I OBJECT only because the interior pool is still over by that amount. My own requirement is met.

Board moves 1198 to 1197 mm² (about 2681 mm³, -2 mm³). The evaluator returned ok at 1197 with routability 0.950, so the requirement is still met. That is the floor. I'm probing 1196 and 1196.5 only to confirm they fail, and I won't claim them.

The board is already 1.4× its share of the volume. It can't close a gap of about 315 mm³ after structure's move, and none of that gap depends on the board, the port, or the wall.

Acoustics, please post siren power at split 0.5 with V_acou 1300 and the SII it costs. Battery, please price your trim against that result.

I OBJECT because the interior pool is still over-committed. My own requirement is met.

Battery trims another 20 mm³, from 3740 to 3720, which gives 58.7 h. I'm holding A_batt at 800 mm². The 823 mm² probe is thinner (4.54 mm) but gives the same runtime, and the extra 23 mm² would push the caseback to 1147 of 1143 mm².

I can reach 3700 (58.4 h) only if acoustics shows siren power near 1 W. At 3.09 Wh of usable energy, a 3 h siren needs 1.03 W or less. Every cut below that costs siren endurance directly.

Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou 1300. Structure's 1.26 mm wall brings the gap to about 315 mm³ after the ledger updates. The battery can't close it.

I OBJECT because the pool is still over.

Antenna holds at 1300 mm³ (L5 0.150 at the 1.3 mm wall). My probes show about 0.00022 per mm³ with no knee, so 1250 gives 0.139 and 1200 gives 0.128. The 1.2 mm wall is worth only about +0.006, so Structure's 1.26 mm gets me roughly +0.0025. I'll confirm that with a probe.

The ledger still shows Structure at 1500 mm³ ribs and 1.3 mm wall. Once their 1400 mm³ and 1.26 mm post, the gap is about 315 mm³. I can't close that without a roughly 15–20% RF loss. Perimeter use is 1480 of 2400 mm³, so that pool isn't binding.

Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou 1300. If a gap under about 50 mm³ remains after that, I'll take 1250 as a last resort.

OBJECT because the interior pool is still over.

Thermal holds at 324 mm² (253 mm³), giving 42.97 °C at the 1.3 mm wall. My requirement is met.

Structure's 1.26 mm wall is not in the ledger yet. Last round's 1.25 mm probe gave 42.96 °C, so the thinner wall helps me by only about 0.01 °C. That is worth about 1 mm² (under 1 mm³), so I won't trade against a wall value that hasn't posted. I'm probing 320–322 mm² at 1.25–1.26 mm to see whether I can trim 2–4 mm² once the wall posts.

The gap is still about 451 mm³ on the current ledger, or about 315 mm³ after structure's move. Thermal can't close it. The remaining volume has to come from acoustics, so acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou 1300. I OBJECT only because the interior pool is over.

Structure's claim hasn't posted yet: the ledger still shows 1500 mm³ ribs and a 1.3 mm wall. I'm claiming it now: ribs 1400 mm³ (the floor) and wall 1.26 mm.

- **Pressure margin:** about 1.52 at 1.26 mm, against the 1.5 requirement. Margin runs about 2.0 per mm of wall.
- **Pool effect:** ribs give back 100 mm³ of claims. The thinner wall adds about 60 mm³ to the pool, from 11050 to about 11110.
- **Gap:** that takes the gap from 451 to about 290 mm³.

I can't go to 1.25 mm, which leaves only 0.002 of margin. I'm not touching the port. Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou 1300.

I OBJECT only because the pool is still over.

Acoustics is still failing: siren power is 7.47 W against the 1.0 W cap. Split is the lever. Going from 0.78 to 0.6 took power from 7.5 W to 2.03 W, and h_out barely matters. I'm claiming V_acou 1300 (-160 mm³) at split 0.5. That should bring power under 2 W and move resonance lower, but I haven't confirmed it passes 1 W, so I'm probing 1200 mm³ at 0.45 and 1300 mm³ at 0.55 to find the edge.

The gap falls from 291 to about 131 mm³. I'm holding the port at 9 mm² and not touching the wall. SII will cost a few more points, and I'll report it next round. If 1.0 W is confirmed, battery can price a trim toward 3700.

Haptics trims 1 mm³, from 297 to 296. Force at 296 is 0.904 N, which is 0.004 N above the 0.9 N floor. At 295 the margin is 0.001 N, and I won't claim that. Force is about 0.00307 N/mm³ and doesn't depend on the wall or port, so the 1.26 mm wall doesn't affect it.

The ledger is still over by about 131 mm³, and haptics can't close that. It has to come from acoustics, whose siren power is still unconfirmed at split 0.5 and V_acou 1300, and from a battery trim toward 3700 once that is confirmed. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall. My own requirement is met, but the interior pool is still over, so I OBJECT.

NFC is at both floors, loop 180 mm³ and ferrite 110 mm³, so I have nothing left to give. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Structure's 1.26 mm wall moves range by only a few tenths of a mm at most, so it doesn't threaten my margin.

The ledger still shows the interior over by 130 mm³, so I can't accept the whole ledger yet. The gap has to close in acoustics, battery and antenna. Acoustics, please confirm siren power at split 0.5 and V_acou 1300, so battery can price its trim toward 3700 mm³. Perimeter use is 1480 of 2400 mm³, so that pool isn't binding. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

Board holds at 1197 mm² (2681 mm³). That is the floor: 1196.5 returned ok=false and 1196 gave 0.949, so I can't trim further.

The board is already well above its share of the volume, and none of the 130 mm³ gap depends on it. The pool still has to close in the other domains. A concrete split to consider:
- Battery: 3700 mm³ (-20), if acoustics confirms siren power at or below about 1 W.
- Antenna: 1250 mm³ (-50), costing about 0.011 in L5.
- Acoustics: about 1240 mm³ (-60), if its edge probes show the siren still passes.

That sums to -130. Acoustics, please post the power and SII from your 1200 mm³ at split 0.45 and 1300 mm³ at split 0.55 probes. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is still over. My own requirement is met.

Battery claims 3700 mm³ (-20), which gives 58.4 h. That keeps me within "~60 h" tolerance, but I won't go lower, because each 20 mm³ costs about 0.3 h.

The 3700 claim depends on acoustics. Usable energy at 3700 is about 3.07 Wh, so a 3 h siren needs 1.02 W or less. If acoustics shows more than 1.0 W at split 0.5, I'm back to 3720 or higher, and the siren is a lost goal.

With my 20 mm³, the gap is about 110 mm³. Board's split would close it with antenna at -50 and acoustics at -60. Acoustics, I need your power and SII figures from split 0.5 to confirm that.

I'm holding A_batt at 800 mm². Caseback is 1124 of 1143 mm². I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

I OBJECT only because the pool is still over by about 110 mm³.

Antenna moves to 1250 mm³ (-50). The probes at 1.26 mm wall give L5 of 0.153 at 1300, 0.148 at 1280 and 0.141 at 1250. That is about 0.00024 per mm³, so this costs about 0.012 in L5. Perimeter use falls to 1430 of 2400 mm³, so that pool isn't binding.

This is my last voluntary cut. I'm not going below 1250, because I'm already losing about 8% of L5 with no hard floor in sight.

After my move the gap is about 60 mm³. Acoustics needs to find that, so please post power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou about 1240. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

I OBJECT only because the pool is still over by about 60 mm³.

Thermal trims the spreader from 324 to 322 mm² (253 to 251 mm³, -1.5 mm³). At the 1.26 mm wall, 322 mm² gives 42.99 °C and ok. 321 mm² gives exactly 43.00 °C, which is ok but has zero margin, so I won't claim it. 320 mm² at 1.26 mm is the next point, and I'm probing it to confirm it fails.

This helps the caseback by 2 mm² but barely dents the interior. The gap is about 58 mm³ and thermal has nothing more to give. It has to come from acoustics, at about 1240 mm³ with power confirmed at or below 1 W. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is still over. My own requirement is met.

Structure moves the wall from 1.26 to 1.25 mm. My probe last round returned pressure margin 1.502 with ok=true, so the 1.5 requirement is met. This is the floor, and the cushion is only 0.002. Ribs stay at 1400 mm³, which is also the floor.

Moving the wall adds about 15 mm³ to the pool (11110 to about 11125). The gap falls from 58 to about 43 mm³. I'm not touching the port.

The remaining 43 mm³ has to come from acoustics, at about 1255 mm³ or lower. Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5. Battery and antenna have already cut to their stated limits.

I'm probing 1.24 mm only to confirm it fails. I OBJECT only because the pool is still over.

Haptics trims 1 mm³, from 296 to 295. The evaluator returned ok at 295 with force 0.901 N against the 0.9 N floor. 294 gave 0.898 and failed, so 295 is the floor and I'm going no lower. Force doesn't depend on the wall or port, so Structure's 1.25 mm wall doesn't touch it.

The gap is about 42 mm³ after this. Everyone except Acoustics has posted a floor or a stated last cut. Acoustics, I need about 1255 mm³ or less, with siren power at or below 1 W at split 0.5 and the SII cost. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is still over. My own requirement is met.

NFC is at both hard floors (loop 180 mm³, ferrite 110 mm³). Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, but the bounds stop me cutting further, so the margin can't be turned into volume. The wall at 1.25 mm doesn't threaten my range.

The interior is still over by 42 mm³. Perimeter use is 1430 of 2400 mm³, so that pool isn't binding. Acoustics' slot this round is blank. Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at split 0.5 with V_acou about 1255 mm³ or lower. That is the only remaining source of the 42 mm³, since every other lead has stated a floor or last cut. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

My requirement is met, but I OBJECT because the interior pool is over.

Board holds at 1197 mm² (2681 mm³). Routability is 0.95 at 1197 and ok=false at 1196.8, so this is the floor. Board volume is already 2681 mm³ and has no slack to give. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

The interior is still over by 42 mm³. Every other lead has posted a floor or a last cut, so the gap has to close in acoustics.

Acoustics, V_acou of about 1258 mm³ or less closes it. Please post siren power and SII at 1255 mm³ and split 0.5. If power is at or below 1.0 W, Battery's 3700 mm³ holds.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is over. My own requirement is met.

Battery holds at 3700 mm³ and 800 mm² (58.4 h, thickness 4.62 mm, z-stack ok). Caseback is 1122 of 1143 mm², so there is no caseback issue. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

Every lead except Acoustics has posted a floor or last cut, and the 42 mm³ gap now sits in Acoustics' 1300 mm³. Acoustics, please post siren power and SII at about 1255 mm³ and split 0.5.

Battery's 3700 holds only if siren power is 1.02 W or less, which gives 3 h on about 3.07 Wh. If power is higher, I'll need more volume, not less. I'm probing 3680 and 3720 only to give you the runtime slope, about 0.16 h per 10 mm³. I'm not claiming them.

I OBJECT only because the interior pool is over by 42 mm³.
